about_the_game:
False Ages - The Fading Light

Welcome to the world of False Ages - The Fading Light, a dark fantasy dungeon-crawling RPG inspired by dungeon crawling classics like Darkest Dungeon and Dragon Quest!

Navigate through dangerous, atmospheric dungeons teeming with deadly foes and nearly impossible powerful bosses, find loot to improve equipment, and stumble upon hidden secrets. With turn-based combat, resource management, and strategic party building, every decision could mean the difference between survival and defeat.

The story follows Cain, an adventurer marked by the ancient power of The Twelve, on his journey toward salvation or doom. As cities vanish into darkness and the Light fades, Cain must gather a party of adventurers to uncover the truth about his mysterious heritage and the world’s looming threat.

Crafted entirely in RPG Maker MZ, The Fading Light combines the nostalgia of retro-style RPGs with intense, tactical gameplay. Explore intricately designed dungeons with no overworld distractions—your focus is survival and success in the heart of the darkness.

The best thing about The Fading Light? Its ability to deliver a challenging and immersive dark fantasy experience that rewards strategic thinking and perseverance. Will you rise above the darkness or succumb to it? The choice is yours.
